prompt: What does the engineer’s proposal allow the trainer to do?
promptZh: 工程師的提議能讓講師怎麼安排練習？
evidence: “I copied yesterday’s case into the practice environment. The activity list still has a gap where a device stopped sending updates. If we connect a device during class, the gap may never appear.” / “I want every group to see the same gap. But don’t make them watch a recording of me choosing what to check. They need to decide whether to examine the device or the activity list first.” / “Then I’ll replay just the incoming updates. The controls will still respond to whatever the learners choose. Should I put a message at the top saying the device disconnected?”

options.text: Give each group the same starting evidence while letting learners choose their own checks.
options.zh: 每組都從同樣的線索開始，但由學員自行選擇要檢查的項目。
options.whyZh: 固定重播收到的資料可讓每組都看到同一段紀錄空白；操作仍會隨學員的選擇回應，不會替他們決定先查什麼。

options.text: Let learners practice on a live device before showing them how an earlier group handled it.
options.zh: 先讓學員用實體裝置練習，再讓他們看看上一組如何處理。
options.whyZh: 工程師表示，上課時直接接裝置可能無法重現空白；講師也不想讓學員照著他人已做的選擇來練習。

options.text: Show each group a full recording and ask which of the trainer’s choices mattered most.
options.zh: 每組看完完整錄影，再判斷講師的哪項選擇最重要。
options.whyZh: 講師明說不要讓學員看她選擇檢查項目的錄影，重點是由學員自行決定。

options.text: Let each group encounter a different gap while following a common sequence of checks.
options.zh: 每組遇到不同的空白，卻按同一順序進行檢查。
options.whyZh: 做法正相反：所有人看相同的空白，但不是按照固定順序檢查。

explanationZh: 固定重播收到的資料可讓每組都看到同一段紀錄空白；操作仍會隨學員的選擇回應，不會替他們決定先查什麼。
